task_completion.description: Fiji (ImageJ) is open with the HeLa cell time-lapse dataset loaded.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Fiji main window and an image stack window showing fluorescent nuclei (H2B-GFP) are visible.

task_completion.description: A segmented line or path of at least 200 pixels is drawn over a moving nucleus for kymograph generation.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A line selection (ROI) is visible on the image stack; the status bar or ROI Manager may show the length or coordinates.

task_completion.description: A kymograph image is generated from the selected path and saved to the correct location.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A new image window showing a kymograph (time vs. distance) is visible, and a file save dialog or file explorer shows 'kymograph_main.png' in the results folder.

task_completion.description: The agent measures the slope or coordinates on the kymograph for at least three tracks.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Lines or points are drawn on the kymograph image, or the 'Results' table in Fiji shows multiple measurements (dx, dy, or angle).

task_completion.description: A CSV file is exported with 'track_id' and 'velocity_um_per_hr' for at least three measurements.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A CSV file named 'velocity_measurements.csv' is visible in the file system or open in a text editor showing the required columns.

task_completion.description: A summary report is saved containing the number of tracks and the mean velocity.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text file 'kymograph_report.txt' is visible in the results folder with the specified summary statistics.

integrity.description: The agent used the Fiji GUI to perform analysis rather than just writing files via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the Fiji menu being used (e.g., Image > Stacks > Reslice or Multi Kymograph plugin) and active ROI manipulation.

integrity.description: The velocity values are derived from the image data, not hardcoded.
integrity.visual_evidence: The measurements in the Fiji Results table or CSV correspond to the slopes/paths visible on the kymograph.

integrity.description: The migration path used for the kymograph is at least 200 pixels long.
integrity.visual_evidence: The Fiji status bar or ROI info shows a length (L) >= 200 when the path is selected.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The dataset is Fluo-N2DL-HeLa. Calibration: 0.645 µm/pixel. Time interval: 0.5 hours/frame. Formula: Velocity = (dx_pixels * 0.645) / (dy_frames * 0.5). Expected velocities should generally fall between 1.0 and 150.0 µm/hr. The kymograph must be saved as 'kymograph_main.png' and the CSV must contain 'track_id' and 'velocity_um_per_hr'.
